approvers: Tax adviser, M&A broker, notary, house bank, key staff, family
reason: Keeping the name, the site and my people is what matters to me, and they put it in writing, so I will hear them out for free. But I have never heard of Always Broke Ltd, they have no earlier sellers to ask, and my life's work is not something I hand to a newcomer on a promise.
objection: Why would my bank, my tax adviser and my notary accept a buyer like this? No track record, no references, and the name alone makes me nervous. The 10% held back for a year is also not nothing.
instead: Keep running the business, keep looking for a successor in the family or among staff, and let my adviser run a process on nexxt-change or with strategic buyers who already own similar firms.
would_change_my_mind: A reference from a comparable owner who has already sold to them, or a known bank or adviser of mine vouching for them, plus a bank letter my own adviser checks before the first real talk.
